gloss: Obon holidays; summer holiday around the Bon festival

definitions.gloss: Obon holidays; summer break around the Bon festival
definitions.explanation: The mid-August holiday period centered on the Buddhist {お盆|ぼん} festival honoring ancestral spirits, during which many businesses close and people return to their hometowns.

examples.japanese: {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I go back to my parents' home for Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This year we have a week off for Obon.

examples.japanese: {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰省|きせい}ラッシュ→帰省ラッシュ：15594_kiseirasshu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{大|おお}⟦{混雑|こんざつ}する→混雑する：25387_konzatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: During the Obon holiday period, both the Shinkansen and the expressways get extremely crowded with returning travelers.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{盆|ぼん}→盆：03897_bon⟧ (the Bon festival) + ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧ (rest, holiday). Centers on August 13–16 in most of Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to begin the Obon holiday
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during the Obon holidays
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧: returning home for Obon
- {盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: just after the Obon holidays

CULTURAL NOTE:
Unlike ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year) and ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧ (Golden Week), {盆休|ぼんやす}み is not a legally mandated holiday — its length varies by company, usually 3 to 7 days. Despite this, it is one of Japan's three major travel periods, with massive congestion on highways and bullet trains.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧: the Obon festival itself — the religious observance rather than the work holiday
- ⟦{夏|なつ}{休|やす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧: summer vacation — broader, especially used for school summer break
